name: keyboardist
description: A declarative way to add keyboard shortcuts to your browser applications — with React hooks and components at keyboardist/react
author: Armando Sosa <arm.sosa@gmail.com>

scripts.check:publish: publint && attw --pack . --profile esm-only && node --input-type=module -e "import{readFileSync}from'node:fs';const react=readFileSync('dist/react/index.js','utf8');const core=readFileSync('dist/index.js','utf8');if(!react.startsWith('\"use client\"')&&!react.startsWith(\"'use client'\")){console.error('dist/react missing use client directive');process.exit(1)};if(core.includes('use client')){console.error('core entry must not carry use client');process.exit(1)}"
